name: Samsung Q80A
summary: The Q80A is the TV Vetro is developed on. Published Q80A records cover launcher behavior, root-agent startup and signed self-updates. In 0.7.0 the firmware update lock and Quick boot were tried on a Q80A on firmware 2310.0. In 0.7.1 the Turn off screen action and the new Home Assistant reads of volume, mute and input were tried on one; the changelog lists the Settings file and the extended update lock as not yet tried on a TV.

name: Samsung Q70A
summary: A community report with a diagnostic export showing the app, the service and the root agent running.

name: Samsung Q60A
summary: Reported working. The reporter changed the listen port to avoid a clash with tizen-youtube, which also listens on a default port.

name: Samsung QN85A
summary: Reported working, and back after a reboot. This report came without a numbered issue.

name: Samsung AU7000
status: Dashboard works; root agent did not connect
summary: Service and dashboard reported working; the root agent did not connect (the Host PC IP step was not confirmed), so the features that need it stay off.

name: Samsung AU7172
summary: Vetro 0.5.0, diagnostic report only: root agent with UID 0, service running and loopback probe succeeded. Whether it starts by itself after a cold boot was not checked.

name: Samsung Q67B
summary: Reported working on firmware 1720.7, the same firmware family as several other 2022 reports.

name: Samsung Q60B
summary: Vetro 0.5.0 on a 43-inch Q60B: dashboard, UID-0 agent, launcher and the physical Home key verified. Service, root and launcher came back by themselves after a software restart, observed after about 100 s. Recovery after a power cut was not tested.

name: Samsung UE65BU8002
summary: Reported working. The Launcher needed the 0.3.1 fix for the Home cache folder before it started on this TV.

name: Samsung QE75QN85B
summary: Core functions were reported working. The Launcher failed before 0.3.1 because of the Home cache folder.

name: Samsung QN90B
summary: Reported working with Vetro 0.5.0, installed with Apps2Samsung: root agent with UID 0 after setting Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1 and restarting. The physical Home key opens a custom launcher. Another cold boot was not tested.

name: Samsung QN55S95B
summary: Reported working on a US-market QD-OLED model.

name: Samsung The Frame LS03B
summary: Reported working. The service started by itself after a cold boot. The Launcher was not tried on this TV. A second LS03B owner later ran the launcher with Vetro 0.5.0 and tested the SVT Play fix that 0.7.0 includes (#200, #211).

summary: Reported working on Tizen 7.0.

name: Samsung S90C (Tizen 9)

description: Samsung S90C QN65S90CAFXZA on Tizen 9 with Vetro: service and root verified with 0.7.0 on firmware T-PTMCAKUC-0090-2220.4. A separate S90C is on Tizen 7.

name: Samsung GU75CU7179

name: Samsung CU8070

description: Samsung DU7000 / DU7179 on Tizen 8 with Vetro: reported working with 0.7.0 on firmware T-KSU2EDDEUC-1400.0 (#313). What was reported and what to check.

name: Samsung S85F
status: Root connected in a test build
summary: Root connected in the contributor's test build, according to the README. An earlier report records root loss after a Samsung firmware update (#308); an update reached this TV with the older update block on, and what happened there is not known yet. Vetro 0.7.1 extends the block, and that is not tried on a TV yet.
note: Root on Tizen 10 starts in Vetro 0.7.1. This report is from a test build; reports for the final 0.7.1 build are still pending and feature coverage varies by model.
description: Samsung S85F on Tizen 10 with Vetro. Root connected in a test build on firmware 2103.1. An earlier report records root loss after a Samsung update.
source: Vetro README; earlier root loss after a firmware update: #308

name: Samsung Odyssey OLED G8
status: Root and launcher verified on a test build
summary: Root, launcher and remote interception were verified on a test build for the input fix (#316, #314). Vetro 0.7.0 offered TV and HDMI 1 to 4 on this monitor and left out USB-C. From 0.7.1, when Samsung's source list holds exactly one HDMI, one DisplayPort and one USB-C port, the launcher, the Remapper and Home Assistant offer those three and read the input back after a switch.
description: Samsung Odyssey OLED G8 (LS34BG850SNXZA) with Vetro: root, launcher and remote verified on a test build, and the HDMI, DisplayPort and USB-C inputs in 0.7.1.

name: Samsung QN80F
description: Samsung QN80F on Tizen 10 with Vetro. Root stopped connecting after a firmware update on 0.5.0 and remains unconfirmed with 0.7.1.
summary: Root stopped connecting with Vetro 0.5.0 after a firmware update (#181). The README says root is still unconfirmed on this model with 0.7.1, which adds a root route for Tizen 10.

name: Samsung M70H
status: Dashboard reported on 0.3.5; root unconfirmed with 0.7.1
description: Samsung M70H on Tizen 10.0 with Vetro. The service and dashboard ran on 0.3.5 but root did not connect. Root is unconfirmed with 0.7.1.
summary: Reported on Tizen 10.0 with Vetro 0.3.5; the firmware version could not be read. The service and dashboard ran on 0.3.5, but the TV's local SDB daemon closed the connection before the handshake finished, so the root agent never started. The README says root remains unconfirmed on this model with 0.7.1, which adds a root route for Tizen 10.
